reconcile.script:
SET log_min_error_statement = panic;
SET log_statement = none;
SET pg_stat_statements.track_utility = off;
\unset password
\getenv password POSTGRES_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', current_user, :'password') \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password ARBEIDSFLATE_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'arbeidsflate' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password CORRESPONDENCE_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'correspondence' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password DIALOGPORTEN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'dialogporten' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_AUTHORIZATION_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_authorization' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_AUTHORIZATION_ADMIN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_authorization_admin' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_EVENTS_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_events' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_EVENTS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_events_admin' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_NOTIFICATIONS_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_notifications' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_NOTIFICATIONS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_notifications_admin' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_PROFILE_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_profile' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_PROFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_profile_admin' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_STORAGE_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_storage' \gexec
\unset password
\getenv password PLATFORM_STORAGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I PASSWORD %L', rolname, :'password') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'platform_storage_admin' \gexec
\unset password
SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('arbeidsflate', 'correspondence', 'dialogporten', 'platform_authorization', 'platform_authorization_admin', 'platform_events', 'platform_events_admin', 'platform_notifications', 'platform_notifications_admin', 'platform_profile', 'platform_profile_admin', 'platform_storage', 'platform_storage_admin') ORDER BY rolname;
